title: Which Egg Hides the Baby Dino?
youtube_title: 🥚 Which Egg Is Hiding the Baby Dino? #Shorts
youtube_description:
Can YOU guess which egg the baby dinosaur is hiding in? Watch to find out! 🦕🥚 Come back tomorrow for Level 2!

#Shorts #KidsVideo #GuessingGame #Dinosaurs #FunForKids #Kidify #BrainTeaser #LearnWithFun

scenes.narration: A baby dinosaur is hiding inside one of these eggs! But which one?
We've got a blue egg, a red egg, and a yellow egg. Pick your favorite!
scenes.visual_prompt: blue red yellow Easter eggs row

scenes.narration: Think you know? The countdown is starting! Three… two… one!
The blue egg cracks open and… it's a rubber duck! Quack quack, not a dino!
The red egg opens and… oh no, it's just a pile of jelly beans! So close!
That means… the YELLOW egg is the one! It cracks open and a tiny baby dino pops out! ROAR!
scenes.visual_prompt: cracked yellow egg baby dinosaur toy

scenes.narration: Did you pick yellow? Nice work! Come back tomorrow for Level 2 — it gets even trickier!
